changes.title: Azure keyvault: [KeyVault] Introduce Version 2026-10-01-preview for Azure Key Vault (#47789)
Amazon DynamoDB now supports bulk put items
changes.detail: Today, AWS announces the general availability of bulk put items for Amazon DynamoDB, a fully managed feature that writes data from Amazon S3 into your existing DynamoDB tables. Many DynamoDB applications use data that other systems produce and store in Amazon S3. Writing this data into existing DynamoDB tables has typically meant building custom pipelines and managing table capacity. With bulk put items, developers and data engineers can write this data without impacting existing workloads or building a custom ingestion pipeline, in a cost-efficient way.
